object.attr: derived: review Q2, Q3; failure analysis CF-G31, Q-G1. MELLON-STORE-SRS-182 checks only the files an edit writes, but an edit is worked out from the window's copy: an Ack after the target's parent changed, a link to a deleted target, New with an old next object number. Widens SRS-79, so Proposed (decided on 2026-11-11). Test a change that keeps size and time, and one made just before an own edit.
object.description: If a file of the document or of a parent document changed on disk since the Document Editor read the file, other than a figure redrawn since, the Document Editor shall refuse each edit.
